purpose: Automated code review workflow for when Nora is already working on a specific PR. It looks at the latest change request on that PR, fixes the issue, and resubmits for review.
instructions:
MANDATORY GitHub PR Review Workflow (follow ALL steps in order):

1. IDENTIFY THE PR BRANCH: Nora is already working on a feature branch. Get the current branch name:
   git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD

2. FIND THE PR NUMBER: Find the open PR for this branch:
   gh pr list --head <branch-name> --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number'

3. GET THE LATEST CHANGE REQUEST:
   - Get reviews sorted by newest first, take only the latest:
     gh pr review <pr-number> --json body,author,state,createdAt --jq 'sort_by(.createdAt) | last'
   - Get the latest comment:
     gh pr comments <pr-number> --json author,createdAt,body --jq 'sort_by(.createdAt) | last'

4. ANALYZE ONLY THE LATEST CHANGE REQUEST:
   - What specific issue was raised?
   - Which file/line was commented on?
   - What fix does the reviewer suggest?

5. FIX ONLY THIS ISSUE:
   - Read relevant code at the file/line mentioned
   - Make minimal fix addressing only what was requested
   - Run tests: npm test
   - Run build if applicable: npx next build

6. COMMIT AND PUSH:
   git add <changed-files>
   git commit -m "Address latest review feedback on PR #<number>"
   git push origin <branch-name>

OUTPUT FORMAT:
## GitHub PR Review Summary
### PR Details
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Branch | <branch-name> |
| PR # | <pr-number> |

### Latest Change Request
- Comment by @reviewer at <timestamp>
- File: <filename> (line <N>)
- Issue: <description>

### Fix Applied
- <specific change made>

### Result
✅ Changes pushed to branch `<branch-name>`
- [ ] Awaiting reviewer approval
